urgency.alert_text: Your account will be locked if you do not reset your password within the next 24 hours.
urgency.body_text:
Hi {{ recipient_name }},

Our security system has detected that your password is about to expire. To ensure uninterrupted access to your account, please reset your password immediately.

If you do not complete this action within 24 hours, your account will be temporarily locked.
urgency.disclaimer: This is an authorized security awareness test. If you did not expect this email, please contact IT Security.
urgency.subject: URGENT: Password Expiration Notice - Action Required
